title: The Lady Xoc statue in a sacrifice pit
description: The City of Gold's Lady Xoc statue took the third room of a sacrifice pit's shaft. The player lifts the pit's golden idol, the floor under it gives way, and he falls a room down onto the statue, not three rooms down into the pit's lava.
